fullText.simplified:
香儿的伤心事（一）

    陈世美是香儿的丈夫，他们住在一个叫陈家村的地方。家里还有六十多岁的父母、一个儿子和一个女儿。他家虽然不是很有钱，但是日子过得还不错。
    陈世美是个读书人，从小就很聪明。他一直都想参加考试，考第一名，然后做大官。他在家里只读书，家里别的事情都是香儿做。香儿不但要洗衣、做饭、还要照顾小孩、照顾父母。香儿每天都很忙。但是香儿想，现在忙一点儿也没关系，只要丈夫考了第一名，他们就有好日子过了。
    三年一次的考试又要开始了。陈世美准备好行李，出发去京城了。走之前，他对香儿说：“你放心，我这次去一定能考第一名。我们夫妻以后一起过更好的日子，白头到老。”
    谁知陈世美走了之后，一点儿消息都没有。他的父母每天想着儿子，孩子们天天想见爸爸，香儿天天苦苦地等着丈夫快点儿回家。
    丈夫没回来，坏事却一件接着一件地来了。陈家村两年都没有下雨，地里什么东西也没有，家里什么吃的东西也没有，钱也花完了。后来，陈世美的父母全都饿死了，孩子们也饿得大哭。
    看着这个家，香儿心里很伤心。想起以前的日子，她不明白，为什么生活一下子就变成这样了？她想：不知道世美在哪里？还在京城吗？现在家已经变成这样了，在家里也是等死，还是去京城看看能不能找到世美吧！所以她决定带着孩子们离开家，去找陈世美。
fullText.traditional:
香兒的傷心事（一）

    陳世美是香兒的丈夫，他們住在一個叫陳家村的地方。家裡還有六十多歲的父母、一個兒子和一個女兒。他家雖然不是很有錢，但是日子過得還不錯。
    陳世美是個讀書人，從小就很聰明。他一直都想參加考試，考第一名，然後做大官。他在家裡只讀書，家裡別的事情都是香兒做。香兒不但要洗衣、做飯、還要照顧小孩、照顧父母。香兒每天都很忙。但是香兒想，現在忙一點兒也沒關係，只要丈夫考了第一名，他們就有好日子過了。
    三年一次的考試又要開始了。陳世美準備好行李，出發去京城了。走之前，他對香兒說：“你放心，我這次去一定能考第一名。我們夫妻以後一起過更好的日子，白頭到老。”
    誰知陳世美走了之後，一點兒消息都沒有。他的父母每天想著兒子，孩子們天天想見爸爸，香兒天天苦苦地等著丈夫快點兒回家。
    丈夫沒回來，壞事卻一件接著一件地來了。陳家村兩年都沒有下雨，地裡什麼東西也沒有，家裡什麼吃的東西也沒有，錢也花完了。後來，陳世美的父母全都餓死了，孩子們也餓得大哭。
    看著這個家，香兒心裡很傷心。想起以前的日子，她不明白，為什麼生活一下子就變成這樣了？她想：不知道世美在哪裏？還在京城嗎？現在家已經變成這樣了，在家裡也是等死，還是去京城看看能不能找到世美吧！所以她決定帶著孩子們離開家，去找陳世美。

sentences.simplified: 陈世美是香儿的丈夫，他们住在一个叫陈家村的地方。
sentences.traditional: 陳世美是香兒的丈夫，他們住在一個叫陳家村的地方。
sentences.pinyin: chén shì měi shì xiāng er de zhàng fu tā men zhù zài yí ge jiào chén jiā cūn de dì fang
sentences.english: Chen Shimei was Xiang’er’s husband. They lived in a place called the Chen family village.

sentences.simplified: 家里还有六十多岁的父母、一个儿子和一个女儿。
sentences.traditional: 家裡還有六十多歲的父母、一個兒子和一個女兒。
sentences.pinyin: jiā lǐ hái yǒu liù shí duō suì de fù mǔ yí ge ér zi hé yí ge nǚ ér
sentences.english: At home lived his parents who were more than 60 years old, a son and a daughter.

sentences.simplified: 他家虽然不是很有钱，但是日子过得还不错。
sentences.traditional: 他家雖然不是很有錢，但是日子過得還不錯。
sentences.pinyin: tā jiā suī rán bú shì hěn yǒu qián dàn shì rì zi guò de hái bú cuò
sentences.english: Although his family wasn’t very rich, life was pretty good.

sentences.simplified: 陈世美是个读书人，从小就很聪明。
sentences.traditional: 陳世美是個讀書人，從小就很聰明。
sentences.pinyin: chén shì měi shì ge dú shū rén cóng xiǎo jiù hěn cōng ming
sentences.english: Chen Shimei was a scholar. He had been very clever since he was small.

sentences.simplified: 他一直都想参加考试，考第一名，然后做大官。
sentences.traditional: 他一直都想參加考試，考第一名，然後做大官。
sentences.pinyin: tā yì zhí dōu xiǎng cān jiā kǎo shì kǎo dì yī míng rán hòu zuò dà guān
sentences.english: He had always wanted to take the examination, win first place, and then become a high official.

sentences.simplified: 他在家里只读书，家里别的事情都是香儿做。
sentences.traditional: 他在家裡只讀書，家裡別的事情都是香兒做。
sentences.pinyin: tā zài jiā lǐ zhǐ dú shū jiā lǐ bié de shì qing dōu shì xiāng er zuò
sentences.english: At home, all he did was study. Everything else at home was done by Xiang’er.

sentences.simplified: 香儿不但要洗衣、做饭、还要照顾小孩、照顾父母。
sentences.traditional: 香兒不但要洗衣、做飯、還要照顧小孩、照顧父母。
sentences.pinyin: xiāng er bú dàn yào xǐ yī zuò fàn hái yào zhào gù xiǎo hái zhào gù fù mǔ
sentences.english: Xiang’er would not only do the washing and cooking, she would also take care of the children and his parents.

sentences.simplified: 香儿每天都很忙。
sentences.traditional: 香兒每天都很忙。
sentences.pinyin: xiāng er měi tiān dōu hěn máng
sentences.english: Xiang’er was very busy every day.

sentences.simplified: 但是香儿想，现在忙一点儿也没关系，
sentences.traditional: 但是香兒想，現在忙一點兒也沒關係，
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì xiāng er xiǎng xiàn zài máng yì diǎn'r yě méi guān xi
sentences.english: But Xiang’er thought, it doesn’t matter if I am busy now.

sentences.simplified: 只要丈夫考了第一名，他们就有好日子过了。
sentences.traditional: 只要丈夫考了第一名，他們就有好日子過了。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yào zhàng fu kǎo le dì yī míng tā men jiù yǒu hǎo rì zi guò le
sentences.english: As long as my husband wins first place in the examination, we will have happy days ahead of us.

sentences.simplified: 三年一次的考试又要开始了。
sentences.traditional: 三年一次的考試又要開始了。
sentences.pinyin: sān nián yí cì de kǎo shì yòu yào kāi shǐ le
sentences.english: The examination that happened once every three years was about to start again.

sentences.simplified: 陈世美准备好行李，出发去京城了。
sentences.traditional: 陳世美準備好行李，出發去京城了。
sentences.pinyin: chén shì měi zhǔn bèi hǎo xíng li chū fā qù jīng chéng le
sentences.english: Chen Shimei packed his luggage to set off for the capital city.

sentences.simplified: 走之前，他对香儿说：“你放心，我这次去一定能考第一名。
sentences.traditional: 走之前，他對香兒說：“你放心，我這次去一定能考第一名。
sentences.pinyin: zǒu zhī qián tā duì xiāng er shuō nǐ fàng xīn wǒ zhè cì qù yí dìng néng kǎo dì yī míng
sentences.english: Before he left, he said to Xiang’er, “Don’t worry. This time I will definitely win first place.

sentences.simplified: 我们夫妻以后一起过更好的日子，白头到老。”
sentences.traditional: 我們夫妻以後一起過更好的日子，白頭到老。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men fū qī yǐ hòu yì qǐ guò gèng hǎo de rì zi bái tóu dào lǎo
sentences.english: Afterwards, we will have an even better life as a couple and grow old together.”

sentences.simplified: 谁知陈世美走了之后，一点儿消息都没有。
sentences.traditional: 誰知陳世美走了之後，一點兒消息都沒有。
sentences.pinyin: shéi zhī chén shì měi zǒu le zhī hòu yì diǎn'r xiāo xi dōu méi yǒu
sentences.english: Unexpectedly. after Chen Shimei left, there wasn’t a single word from him.

sentences.simplified: 他的父母每天想着儿子，孩子们天天想见爸爸，
sentences.traditional: 他的父母每天想著兒子，孩子們天天想見爸爸，
sentences.pinyin: tā de fù mǔ měi tiān xiǎng zhe ér zi hái zi men tiān tiān xiǎng jiàn bà ba
sentences.english: His parents missed him every day, and the children wanted to see their dad every day.

sentences.simplified: 香儿天天苦苦地等着丈夫快点儿回家。
sentences.traditional: 香兒天天苦苦地等著丈夫快點兒回家。
sentences.pinyin: xiāng er tiān tiān kǔ kǔ de děng zhe zhàng fu kuài diǎn'r huí jiā
sentences.english: Every day, Xiang’er agonizingly waited for her husband to come home soon.

sentences.simplified: 丈夫没回来，坏事却一件接着一件地来了。
sentences.traditional: 丈夫沒回來，壞事卻一件接著一件地來了。
sentences.pinyin: zhàng fu méi huí lái huài shì què yí jiàn jiē zhe yí jiàn de lái le
sentences.english: Her husband did not come home. Meanwhile, a series of misfortunes occurred.

sentences.simplified: 陈家村两年都没有下雨，
sentences.traditional: 陳家村兩年都沒有下雨，
sentences.pinyin: chén jiā cūn liǎng nián dōu méi yǒu xià yǔ
sentences.english: It didn’t rain in the Chen family village for two years.

sentences.simplified: 地里什么东西也没有，家里什么吃的东西也没有，钱也花完了。
sentences.traditional: 地裡什麼東西也沒有，家裡什麼吃的東西也沒有，錢也花完了。
sentences.pinyin: dì lǐ shén me dōng xi yě méi yǒu jiā lǐ shén me chī de dōng xi yě méi yǒu qián yě huā wán le
sentences.english: No food grew, there was nothing to eat at home, and all the money was gone.

sentences.simplified: 后来，陈世美的父母全都饿死了，孩子们也饿得大哭。
sentences.traditional: 後來，陳世美的父母全都餓死了，孩子們也餓得大哭。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái chén shì měi de fù mǔ quán dōu è sǐ le hái zi men yě è de dà kū
sentences.english: Later, Chen Shimei’s parents starved to death, and the children cried out in hunger.

sentences.simplified: 看着这个家，香儿心里很伤心。
sentences.traditional: 看著這個家，香兒心裡很傷心。
sentences.pinyin: kàn zhe zhè ge jiā xiāng er xīn li hěn shāng xīn
sentences.english: Seeing this family, Xiang’er was devastated inside.

sentences.simplified: 想起以前的日子，她不明白，为什么生活一下子就变成这样了？
sentences.traditional: 想起以前的日子，她不明白，為什麼生活一下子就變成這樣了？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng qǐ yǐ qián de rì zi tā bù míng bai wèi shén me shēng huó yí xià zi jiù biàn chéng zhè yàng le
sentences.english: Thinking back to the old days, she couldn’t understand why her life all of a sudden became like this?

sentences.simplified: 她想：不知道世美在哪里？还在京城吗？
sentences.traditional: 她想：不知道世美在哪裏？還在京城嗎？
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng bù zhī dào shì měi zài nǎ lǐ hái zài jīng chéng ma
sentences.english: She thought, “I wonder where Shimei is? Is he still in the capital city?

sentences.simplified: 现在家已经变成这样了，在家里也是等死，
sentences.traditional: 現在家已經變成這樣了，在家裡也是等死，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài jiā yǐ jīng biàn chéng zhè yàng le zài jiā lǐ yě shì děng sǐ
sentences.english: Our family is now in this state. If we stay at home, we will just be waiting for death.

sentences.simplified: 还是去京城看看能不能找到世美吧！
sentences.traditional: 還是去京城看看能不能找到世美吧！
sentences.pinyin: hái shi qù jīng chéng kàn kan néng bù néng zhǎo dào shì měi ba
sentences.english: We might as well go to the capital city to see if we can find Shimei!”

sentences.simplified: 所以她决定带着孩子们离开家，去找陈世美。
sentences.traditional: 所以她決定帶著孩子們離開家，去找陳世美。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā jué dìng dài zhe hái zi men lí kāi jiā qù zhǎo chén shì měi
sentences.english: So she decided to take her children away from home to go and find Chen Shimei.

Chen Shimei, a Chinese opera character and a byword in China for a heartless and unfaithful man

sentence_translations: Xiang’er’s Heartbreaking Story (1)
Chen Shimei was Xiang’er’s husband. They lived in a place called the Chen family village.
At home lived his parents who were more than 60 years old, a son and a daughter.
Although his family wasn’t very rich, life was pretty good.
Chen Shimei was a scholar. He had been very clever since he was small.
He had always wanted to take the examination, win first place, and then become a high official.
At home, all he did was study. Everything else at home was done by Xiang’er.
Xiang’er would not only do the washing and cooking, she would also take care of the children and his parents.
Xiang’er was very busy every day.
But Xiang’er thought, it doesn’t matter if I am busy now.
As long as my husband wins first place in the examination, we will have happy days ahead of us.
The examination that happened once every three years was about to start again.
Chen Shimei packed his luggage to set off for the capital city.
Before he left, he said to Xiang’er, “Don’t worry. This time I will definitely win first place.
Afterwards, we will have an even better life as a couple and grow old together.”
Unexpectedly. after Chen Shimei left, there wasn’t a single word from him.
His parents missed him every day, and the children wanted to see their dad every day.
Every day, Xiang’er agonizingly waited for her husband to come home soon.
Her husband did not come home. Meanwhile, a series of misfortunes occurred.
It didn’t rain in the Chen family village for two years.
No food grew, there was nothing to eat at home, and all the money was gone.
Later, Chen Shimei’s parents starved to death, and the children cried out in hunger.
Seeing this family, Xiang’er was devastated inside.
Thinking back to the old days, she couldn’t understand why her life all of a sudden became like this?
She thought, “I wonder where Shimei is? Is he still in the capital city?
Our family is now in this state. If we stay at home, we will just be waiting for death.
We might as well go to the capital city to see if we can find Shimei!”
So she decided to take her children away from home to go and find Chen Shimei.
